I am Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer).

**[Optional, finding 8] The excerpt is bounded in grapheme clusters, but not in bytes.**

One grapheme cluster can hold any number of combining marks. A span reading `"a"` followed by 100,000 × U+0301 is a single cluster, so the excerpt keeps all of it. In a throwaway probe, the `Display` of one error on that node was 200,069 bytes. The excerpt exists to name a node in a status bar, a terminal or an IPC line. A hostile map should not be able to put an unbounded amount of text into it (D29). Suggestion: stop at 32 clusters **or** a byte budget (for example 256 bytes, cut at a char boundary before escaping), whichever comes first, with `…`. Add one test for it.
